title: Beyond Scene Description: Multi-Agent Orchestration for Non-visual Access to Virtual Worlds
abstract: arXiv:2609.14512v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Virtual worlds now host classrooms, meetings, conferences, shops, and social venues, and nearly every interaction they expose assumes a user who can scan a three-dimensional scene, follow avatars, and read floating panels. Blind and visually impaired (BVI) users are left with assistive tools that each solve one task in isolation: naming an object, reading text, describing a scene, or planning a route. A live virtual room defeats that model: obstacles, speakers, gestures, chat, slides, and notifications arrive together, and a tool that narrates all of them trades a visual barrier for an auditory one. This paper presents MetaBlind, an architecture that distributes nonvisual access across eight specialized agents, spanning perception, navigation, social and object interaction, communication, safety and trust, memory, and personalization, and that places an Accessibility Orchestrator between those agents and the user. translated_title: 超越场景描述：面向虚拟世界非视觉访问的多智能体编排
translated_abstract: 虚拟世界如今承载着课堂、会议、大会、商店和社交场所，它们所提供的几乎所有交互都默认用户能够浏览三维场景、跟踪虚拟形象并阅读浮动面板。盲人和视障（BVI）用户只能依靠各自孤立解决单一任务的辅助工具：命名物体、阅读文本、描述场景或规划路线。而一个实时虚拟房间打破了这种模式：障碍物、发言者、手势、聊天、幻灯片和通知同时涌现，一个将所有内容都朗读出来的工具只会把视觉障碍转变为听觉障碍。本文提出了MetaBlind，这是一种将非视觉访问分配给八个专门智能体的架构，涵盖感知、导航、社交与物体交互、通信、安全与信任、记忆以及个性化，并在这些智能体与用户之间设置了一个无障碍编排器。智能体发布候选……
tldr: 本文提出MetaBlind架构，通过无障碍编排器协调八个专门智能体（涵盖感知、导航、社交交互、通信、安全、记忆和个性化等功能），为盲人和视障用户提供对虚拟世界的整体性非视觉访问，克服了传统辅助工具只能孤立解决单一任务、易造成听觉信息过载的局限。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes MetaBlind, an architecture that distributes nonvisual access across eight specialized agents coordinated by an Accessibility Orchestrator, enabling blind and visually impaired users to holistically access virtual worlds and overcoming the limitations of traditional assistive tools that solve tasks in isolation and trade visual barriers for auditory overload.
